help.goal: Plant, water, harvest and sell. One season mode asks for $3000 in 40 days; Chill farms forever.
steps: Pick a tool chip, then tap a plot to use it.
🪓 till bare dirt, then tap a seed chip to sow.
Water every dry crop with 💧 before the day ends.
Gather ripe crops and full pens with ✋, then 💰 Sell barn.
Tap 🌙 End day once your energy runs out.
notes: Every chore costs one energy; 🥾 boots give you more each day.
A crop only grows on a day it was watered, and dies after three dry days.
Market prices move every day, so hold the barn until yours is high.
